Recorded clothes-stand interaction: sources and attribution

The human demonstration and underlying object geometry originate with:
Jiaman Li, Jiajun Wu, C. Karen Liu. Object Motion Guided Human Motion Synthesis.
ACM Transactions on Graphics (SIGGRAPH Asia), 2023.
https://lijiaman.github.io/projects/omomo/

The object asset was processed by InterMimic:
Sirui Xu, Hung Yu Ling, Yu-Xiong Wang, Liang-Yan Gui. InterMimic: Towards
Universal Whole-Body Control for Physics-Based Human-Object Interactions.
CVPR, 2025. https://github.com/Sirui-Xu/InterMimic
The corresponding MIT object-asset notices are in OMOMO-OBJECTS-LICENSE.txt.

Initial retargeting reference: HOI-Retarget: Contact-Centric Retargeting for
Human-Object Interaction. Jihwan Shin, Adria Lopez Escoriza, Junzhe He,
Matthias Heyrman, Marco Hutter, 2026.
https://github.com/leggedrobotics/hoi-retarget
https://huggingface.co/datasets/leggedrobotics/hoi-retarget
The upstream motion dataset is distributed under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. The
source-derived playback data here is shared under those same terms:
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0/
The recorded robot motions result from HuMoTAR controller execution or verified
replays. Geometry transforms are packed and interpolated for browser playback;
inspected images are resized and compressed. Source human body models, model
weights and raw experiment archives are not included.

G1 robot assets: Unitree Robotics; see UNITREE-LICENSE.txt (BSD-3-Clause).
Three.js and OrbitControls: see THREE-LICENSE.txt (MIT).
These data and asset terms do not change the licenses of the viewer libraries.
